notices.title: Private credit, not Treasuries
notices.message: ACRED is a feeder into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, which holds direct lending and structured credit positions. Risk profile is medium-to-high and closer to syrupUSDC than to BUIDL or BENJI. Token transfers are permissioned and redemption is monthly at NAV via Securitize Markets, with an on-demand pool sized to ~5% of NAV. ACRED is also issued on Aptos, Avalanche, Ink, Polygon, Solana, and Sei via Wormhole; Pharos tracks only the Ethereum supply contract pending per-chain verification.
